notes.title: Bug fixes and improvements!
notes.content:
[h2]1.02[/h2]

[h3]- Now there is a clue to get you all the achievements. It is obtained after reaching the top.[/h3]

- The map boundary was not working, allowing you to go outside of the playable area. Now you can't.

- Fixed some collisions.

- Fixed Spanish and English language translations.

- Fixed some stones that were considered ice, now they are just that... stones.

- The stone on the top now has sounds and particles of stone and not snow.

[h2]1.01[/h2]

- Fixed a ghost collision near the end of the game.
